towers.name: Dart
towers.description: Cheap, fast, and reliable early damage. Best used in groups to cover long lanes.

towers.name: Ice
towers.description: Slows enemies so other towers get more time to fire. Strong near corners and crowded choke points.

towers.name: Zap
towers.description: Chains lightning between nearby enemies. Great when waves bunch up, weaker against spread-out targets.

towers.name: Sniper
towers.description: Long-range single-target damage for picking off tough enemies. Place where it can see as much path as possible.

towers.name: Poison
towers.description: Applies lingering poison that keeps hurting enemies after the hit. Best when enemies survive long enough for the poison to tick.

towers.name: Bank
towers.description: Generates extra coins during waves instead of attacking. Build early if you can survive with fewer weapons.

towers.name: Tesla
towers.description: Heavy chain lightning with stronger multi-target pressure. Excellent against dense waves and mixed enemy packs.

towers.name: Fire
towers.description: Fast fire attacks apply burn damage over time. Strong into steady waves that stay alive long enough to burn.

towers.name: Haste
towers.description: Boosts nearby towers so they attack faster. Put it in the middle of your best damage cluster.

towers.name: Power
towers.description: Raises nearby tower damage for bigger hits. Pairs well with slow, sniper, rail, and other high-value attacks.

towers.name: Guard
towers.description: Spawns guards that block and fight enemies on the path. Upgrades make them tougher and eventually add ranged fire.

towers.name: Void
towers.description: Creates slowing blasts that control groups of enemies. Use it to buy time for your heavy damage towers.

towers.name: Ranger
towers.description: High-rate precision damage with strong range. A flexible late-game tower for cleaning up leaks.

towers.name: Rail
towers.description: Expensive piercing shots that punish enemies lined up on the path. Best on long straight sections.

towers.name: Orbital
towers.description: Locks on with a continuous beam for elite single-target damage. Costly, but devastating when protected by support.
